notes: Waow's Band was missing from the dev spawn list, and so were forty-nine other items. The list was a hand-written block of option tags in index.html and it had drifted fifty behind the catalog: every new-pack necklace, hat, top, trouser and shoe was unspawnable, and nobody had reason to find out until they went looking for a specific one. ADDING ONE OPTION WOULD HAVE FIXED THE REPORT AND LEFT THE BUG. The select is now built at panel open from ITEM_CATALOG_CLIENT, which is a byte-for-byte mirror of the server catalog: grouped by slot in the canonical slot order, sorted by rarity then name. Verified by evaluating the real client catalog and diffing the emitted option ids against the server's: 195 out of 195, nothing missing in either direction. Hats go from 10 entries to 19. Every item added from here on shows up without anyone remembering to add it, WHICH IS THE ACTUAL FIX. The 145 hardcoded options are deleted and the empty select carries a comment saying not to put them back. Phantom planets are listed but flagged UNIQUE, because rollItemDrop filters out ones already owned and handing one out from the panel skips that check. CLIENT ONLY. No server change, no restart needed. Hard refresh.
